discoveries.headline: How fake crypto platforms hook investors
discoveries.why: ASIC lays out a scam it keeps seeing: 'stock tips' groups on social media and messaging apps steer people onto fake crypto platforms that show made-up profits, then demand 'release' fees when they try to withdraw. Its STOP, CHECK, PROTECT steps include checking a platform on AUSTRAC's register and calling your bank straight away if you've sent money. Five minutes that could save someone you love a lot of grief. Education, not advice.

discoveries.headline: COP31's final days in Antalya
discoveries.why: The UN climate talks in Antalya are due to wrap up today, and UN News explains what's still on the table: climate finance, adaptation, a just transition, fossil fuel language and an overarching 'cover' decision first drafted by Australia as co-host and lead negotiator. Laurence Tubiana and Mary Robinson are among the voices weighing in. A clear briefing before the final headlines land.
discoveries.meta_credit: UN News · Laura Quinones in Antalya

discoveries.headline: A chapel under the stars wins
discoveries.why: Glenn Young's 'Chapel to the Stars' took the overall title in The Landscape Awards 2026, chosen from more than 2,000 entries across landscape, seascape, aerial and urban categories. Look for Vicki Moritz's 'Apostles Sea Mist' and Paul Hoelen's 'Ghost trees' too. The awards also raised more than $4,600 for The Wilderness Society.
discoveries.credit: © Glenn Young (overall winner), Vicki Moritz, Paul Hoelen, Levin Barrett, Dani Watson, Robert Jarmyn, Gergo Rugli, Crystal May, Roxanne Weston, Jesso Coleman and Drew Buckmaster

discoveries.headline: Loving-kindness with Sharon Salzberg
discoveries.why: Sharon Salzberg, co-founder of the Insight Meditation Society, guides a 20-minute loving-kindness practice, starting with yourself and widening out to friends and then all beings. As she puts it, you don't have to force a special feeling: just rest your attention on simple phrases like 'may I be safe, be happy'. A gentle way to start the weekend.

discoveries.headline: When being doubted drives you
discoveries.why: On this week's Hidden Brain, Shankar Vedantam talks with Wharton's Samir Nurmohamed about the 'underdog effect': how being underestimated can push people to work harder and do what others thought impossible. Tom Brady, the 199th pick in his draft, is just the start. A thoughtful listen for the commute.
discoveries.meta_credit: Hidden Brain · Shankar Vedantam · Samir Nurmohamed

discoveries.headline: Fiona O'Byrne wins the Lester Prize
discoveries.why: Melbourne painter Fiona O'Byrne has won the $50,000 Richard Lester Prize for Portraiture with 'Luci, now', an intimate oil-on-linen portrait of her daughter, whom she has painted for more than a decade. She trained as a landscape architect and only turned to oil painting in her mid-thirties. Proof it's never too late to find your medium.

discoveries.headline: Five Ayurvedic ways to stay cool
discoveries.why: With summer around the corner in Australia, the Art of Living Retreat Center shares five simple Ayurvedic tips for calming pitta, the fiery dosha: cooling foods and drinks like takra (spiced, watered-down yogurt), cool showers and natural fabrics, gentler exercise, and cooling breathwork such as Sheetali. Easy summer rituals to try this weekend. General information, not medical advice.

discoveries.headline: A 27-minute morning flow for tight hips
discoveries.why: Aly from Fitness Blender leads a free, full-body morning flow: a warm-up, two flow phases through low lunge, Warrior 1 and 2 and pigeon, then a cool-down in happy baby. All you need is a mat and a yoga block. A lovely way to wake up stiff hips before the day gets going.

discoveries.headline: Lifting weights after 60
discoveries.why: This HealthDay piece, featuring Baylor College of Medicine orthopaedic specialist Dr Adil Ahmed, explains why it's never too late to lift. It cites a study of more than 200,000 older adults that linked any weight training to a lower risk of death, and shares easy starting tips: begin with body weight, add resistance once you can do eight good reps, and lower slowly. Rituals that protect bones and heart.
discoveries.meta_credit: HealthDay · Dr Adil Ahmed, Baylor College of Medicine
